diagnosis: The query handler replays the cart aggregate stream from EventStoreDB using cartId from the URL without checking if the current session owns cartId. An attacker can inspect historical item additions, coupon codes, and shipping addresses entered by other shoppers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/queries/carts/cart_guest_89201a/audit HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.storefront.io
Authorization: Bearer <shopper_token>
